assumptions: One adapter host; no external writers; reconciliation requires retry of pending requests.

field_mappings.status: confirmed becomes paid; cancelled remains cancelled

field_mappings.items: lines mapped to sku and quantity

field_mappings.page,page_size: slice published mappings sorted by stable legacy ID
field_mappings.orders: only successfully published workflows, including cancelled orders

evidence.pointer: Supported failure policy: identifier publication and bounded listings

workflow.name: draft
workflow.retry: Validate legacy schema first. Persist full input fingerprint and attempt-specific upstream key before calling; replay identical key and body after ambiguity. Checkpoint returned reference before reservation.
workflow.compensation: No business effects for rejected draft; any known draft rejected later must be voided.

workflow.name: reserve
workflow.retry: Replay same order_ref after 503; checkpoint acknowledged completion.
workflow.compensation: Persist permanent failure and enter void stage.

workflow.name: payment
workflow.retry: Replay identical order_ref, amount, token and durable payment key after 503; never compensate an ambiguous payment.
workflow.compensation: Only a permanent rejection transitions to void.

workflow.name: confirm
workflow.retry: Replay idempotently after 503; checkpoint confirmed success before allocating legacy ID.
workflow.compensation: Void on permanent rejection before reporting final error.

workflow.name: void
workflow.retry: Durably retain compensation stage and original error; retry void until acknowledged, returning PENDING on failure. Also used for repeat-safe cancellation.
workflow.compensation: Atomic upstream release and refund; no further compensation.

idempotency_strategy: Serialize entire requests with ctx.lock. Store full legacy input fingerprint including token, attempt generation, upstream keys, order_ref and workflow stage durably. Pending or successful keys reject changed bodies; successful replays fetch current order. Completed rejected attempts permit fresh attempts with incremented upstream key generation, only after compensation has completed.
identifier_strategy: Allocate ctx.id_for only after acknowledged confirmation; resolve reads and cancellation through ctx.upstream_id; never publish failed drafts.
pagination_strategy: Enumerate published mappings, sort by stable legacy integer, slice page and page_size, and fetch current orders. Support at most 10000 published mappings and at most 80 selected orders per request; larger requests return 503 PENDING rather than partial success.
limitations: Pending workflows can expose temporary inventory effects; temporal atomic visibility is not preserved.
Retry is required for reconciliation after restart or ambiguous responses.
Single host only; external writers, shipping, multi-currency, auth migration and noncompensable payments unsupported.
Listings bounded to 10000 published mappings and 80 selected orders per request.
